alt: The white domed building of Gurdwara Janam Asthan at Nankana Sahib under a blue sky, with a palm tree and a paved approach.
caption: Gurdwara Janam Asthan at Nankana Sahib, Pakistan, built where Guru Nanak Dev Ji is remembered to have been born.

alt: Gurdwara Ber Sahib in Sultanpur Lodhi, a white building with a large dome, with visitors walking in front.
caption: Gurdwara Ber Sahib in Sultanpur Lodhi, beside the Bein, marks the place associated with Guru Nanak Dev Ji's experience at the river.

alt: An illustrated manuscript page with lines of Gurmukhi text above a painted scene of seated figures in a landscape.
caption: A page from a janamsakhi manuscript made in 1733, one of the oldest surviving illustrated accounts of Guru Nanak Dev Ji's life. British Library, MS Panj. B 40.

alt: A traditional painting of Guru Nanak Dev Ji and Bhai Mardana seated at the home of Bhai Lalo.
caption: Guru Nanak Dev Ji and Bhai Mardana at the home of Bhai Lalo, from a janamsakhi painting of the 17th or 18th century.

alt: An open illustrated manuscript showing Guru Nanak Dev Ji with Bhai Mardana holding a rabab and Bhai Bala, meeting two figures with horses.
caption: Guru Nanak Dev Ji with Bhai Mardana and Bhai Bala meeting travellers, from a janamsakhi painting, probably 18th or 19th century.

alt: Gurdwara Darbar Sahib at Kartarpur, a white building with a central dome, reflected on a wide wet marble courtyard.
caption: Gurdwara Darbar Sahib at Kartarpur, Pakistan, where Guru Nanak Dev Ji spent his final years.

alt: An old black and white photograph of the brick gateway and upper storey of Gurdwara Darbar Sahib at Khadur Sahib.
caption: Gurdwara Darbar Sahib at Khadur Sahib, where Guru Angad Dev Ji lived, photographed in the late 19th or early 20th century.
